name: crios
description: Work with Crios projects, build sessions, workflows, and connectors from Cursor.

CRIOS_BASE_URL.title: Crios base URL
CRIOS_BASE_URL.description: Origin of your Crios API or web app, such as https://api.example.com or http://127.0.0.1:8080. Do not include a token in the URL.

CRIOS_TOKEN.title: Crios personal access token
CRIOS_TOKEN.description: Personal access token from Crios Settings → API tokens. It starts with crios_pat_. A full-access token is required for workflows.
